name: Sinulog sa Dipolog
description: Dipolog's own Sinulog — the street-dance festival held in January in honour of the Santo Niño.
note: The City's socio-economic profile lists the 4th Saturday of January; Wikipedia lists the 3rd Saturday. Confirm the date with the City Tourism Office.

name: Katkat Sakripisyo
description: A spiritual trek up the 3,003 Steps to Linabo Peak and a re-enactment of the passion and death of Jesus Christ, gathering the Catholic community of Zamboanga del Norte and visitors.
note: Good Friday falls in March or April depending on the year.

name: Dipolog P'gsalabuk Festival
schedule: Starts the 3rd week of April; culminates July 1
description: P'gsalabuk is a Subanen term meaning "togetherness". Billed as a celebration of unity amidst diversity among Mindanao's tri-people (Subanen, Muslims and Christians), the festival features ethnic street dancing, sports, concerts, a pageant and cultural shows. A highlight is the annual triathlon of swimming, running and cycling. The celebration culminates on July 1, Adlaw sa Dipolog.
note: The City's published dates vary between pages (3rd week of April to the 4th Saturday of May, or through July 1). Check the City's announcements for the current year's programme.

name: Feast of St. Vincent Ferrer
description: The Dipolog City fiesta in honour of the city's patron saint. A religious procession winds through the city's major streets and ends at the church patio, where devotees dance before the image of St. Vincent Ferrer to the beat of drums.

name: Adlaw sa Dipolog (Araw ng Dipolog)
schedule: Last week of June to July 1
description: Dipolog City's founding anniversary — Dipolog became a municipality on July 1, 1913 and a chartered city effective July 1, 1970. Celebrated with inter-government-agency sports activities and the recognition of exemplary Dipolognons.

name: Dahunog sa Dipolog
schedule: Last week of September to October 7
description: A series of interschool competitions highlighted by a parade band competition and the Miss Teen Tourism Dipolog pageant. The festival takes its name from the sound (dahunog) of the bands and drums that fill the city streets.

name: Feast of Our Lady of the Holy Rosary
description: The feast of the titular patroness of Dipolog Cathedral. The Marian celebration runs for the whole month and ends with a Rosary Crusade at the city plaza on October 31.

name: Pasko sa Dipolog (PASADI)
description: In preparation for Christmas, Dipolog holds nightly shows and decorates its streets and plazas with lights and decorations to inspire holiday spirit and unity.
